messages:
marc: Postmortem posted: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-22. Root cause = KV cache eviction under burst + model warmup thundering herd. We need an SLO tune + error budget rebalance for the model-inference path. Propose temporarily relax p95 from 450ms -> 600ms for 2 weeks while we stabilize and add cache protections. Who can own the SLO change + dashboard updates + customer comms? cc @kim @anna

anna: I can take the SLO change and open the policy PR. ETA end of next week (7 business days). Will include canary rollout window and a perf regression checkpoint in CI.

kim: I can update Grafana and add a Recent Incidents panel. Can someone paste the exact p95 query we should use for the dashboards?

marc: Use this for p95 latency on inference service (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Also add series for kv_eviction_rate and cache_hit_ratio.

rafael: From product/CS side — if we relax SLOs internally, what's the SLA impact for Dedicated customers? We need to be explicit in any advisory.

anna: SLA stays as-is (no contractual change). This is an internal SLO adjustment to prevent noisy rollbacks while we fix the root cause. Rafael, can you draft a short advisory for CSM/legal that clarifies this?

rafael: Yep — I'll draft and loop in legal and CSM. ETA 3 days.

oncall-bot: Created ticket INF-4123 - "SLO rebalance + dashboards + customer advisory". Link: https://jira.redwood/INF-4123

kim: I'll start the dashboard PR and deploy to staging today. PR: https://git.redwood/ops/dashboards/pull/88 :eyes:

marc: Action list (owners & rough deadlines):
- anna: update SLO policy + PR -> due 1766036900 (1 week)
- kim: dashboard changes + staging deploy -> due 1765460000 (EOD today)
- rafael: customer advisory draft -> due 1765640000 (3 days)
- marc: rollout policy + alert tuning + monitor guardrails -> owning rollout and canary checks
Please add these to INF-4123 and link related PRs.

anna: :thumbsup: assigning INF-4123 to me and I'll link the SLO PR when ready.

kim: Deployed dashboards to staging, watching metrics. Plan: promote to prod after one hour of canary stability. If p95 spikes > 800ms during canary -> rollback to previous dashboard + alert.

marc: Also creating INF-4124 to track recurring KV eviction alerts and longer-term mitigation (cache sizing, eviction backoff).

oncall-bot: Created ticket INF-4124 - "Recurring KV eviction alerts". Link: https://jira.redwood/INF-4124

rafael: Thanks all. Let's revisit in tomorrow's SRE standup (sync 10:15). If anything changes before then, drop a quick note here. :white_check_mark:
